svg.text: Every pin cross-checked against firmware/include/pins.h, firmware/src/sensors.cpp, pi/config.py and docs/circuit-diagram.md §2–§6. Colour = pin function (see legend).
Field build: 4S LiFePO4 — divider example below shows the 3S LiPo bench pack; with 39k/10k the 4S full-charge tap is 14.6 V ⇒ 2.98 V (< 3.3 V ✓).
Neo-6M GPS RX (UART1 TX, DGPS/RTCM opt.)
DPDT actuator direction — Branch B only
TX0/RX0 → CP2102 → Pi USB (UART0 AI link)
FREE (was L298N ENA) — BTS7960 EN tied 3.3V
3.3V — DHT pull-up, divider top ref, BTS7960 R_EN/L_EN/VCC
ADC1 pins 34/35/36 are WiFi-safe and INPUT-ONLY (no pull-ups, no output). No flash pins (GPIO6–11) used.
Power moisture (34) & TDS (36) sensors from 3.3V — a 5V-fed AOUT can exceed 3.3V and destroy the ADC pin.
Drive PWM: 4× LEDC ch0–3, timers 0/1 @ 1kHz, 8-bit. Servo: LEDC ch4, timer2 @ 50Hz.
Relays are ACTIVE-LOW in firmware (dosing.cpp: relayOn = digitalWrite LOW). Sequence: pump 1.5s pre-soak → actuator extend → dose → retract.
ESP32-CAM is ISOLATED: 5V + GND + 16GB microSD only, own WiFi — no data line to this MCU.
Raspberry Pi 4 (BCM numbering, 40-pin header) — AI inference
BUS → BTS7960 ×2 +Vmot, Relay COM, P6KE15A TVS
5V RAIL → ESP32 VIN (ferrite), HC-SR04, MAX485, sensors, ESP32-CAM
Set buck to exactly 5.00V with a DMM BEFORE connecting the ESP32.
Pi is powered separately from a 10000mAh bank — two independent 5V domains.
Battery sense: BAT+ —[39k]—•— GPIO35 ; •—[10k]—GND ⇒ 2.98V @ 14.6V (4S LiFePO4 full) / 2.57V @ 12.6V (3S LiPo bench) (< 3.3V ✓)
Verified 2026-07-07 against: firmware/include/pins.h · firmware/src/{sensors,dosing}.cpp · pi/config.py · docs/circuit-diagram.md
This is a signal-level pin map; wire high-current paths (B+/B−/M±) from circuit-diagram.md §5.1.
